Class 11 Physics · Thermal properties of matter
Physics, visualised #15

Two glasses of the same drink with the same ice. In one it floats; in the other a mesh holds it down.
Watch the colour: it is the temperature. 5 minutes, sped up to 8 seconds.
Then a second question, about your fridge.
Convection comes up in JEE Main, NEET and MHT-CET.

The drink is a model in 24 layers (water is densest at 4 °C). Single-door fridges cool by convection; double-door ones use a fan.
